amount.description: The amount to be collected. Specify `0` for static accounts

reference.description: A custom identifier to track the transaction, This must be unique across all your transactions

status.description: The status of the virtual account

account_expiration_datetime.description: The expiry date and time of the virtual account

note.description: A message providing instructions for the bank transfer, which includes the narration provided in the request

created_datetime.description: The date and time when the virtual account was created

customer_reference.description: This is the reference the customer sends as narration when making the bank transfer

narration.description: This allows you specify the name shown when the account is resolved
